release_notes:
EzTab Pro Update
• Fixed: tablet unlocked with no time after long idle
• Fixed: tablet not locking when paid time ends (Centralize/Smart)
• Fixed: lock flash after adding coins at 0:00
• Fixed: EzTab not returning after restart on Itel tablets
• Fixed: floating timer disappearing mid-session
• New: Keep EzTab Running card (Lock Launcher + Wake Tablet)
• New: heartbeat timer edge (green / amber / red)
• New: Hide Timer (dot, auto-returns at 0:30)
• Improved: cleaner timer hold menu
• Improved: auto-restart after app update and reboot

Centralize Firmware v4.7
• Fixed: charging turning on/off when screen times out
• Fixed: coins ignored after 49+ days uptime
